lines.en: The whole thicket only reaches my knees.
My legs move one then the other, slowly.
I step into the shallow water of the cavern.
The water barely reaches my ankles.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方雪被压实。
lines.en: Snow packs firm where I walk.
I duck under the cave roof.
My shoulder scrapes the rock wall.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，但每步都远。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but each step is long.
I go around the stone pillars.
I stop; there's an echo in the cave.

lines.zh: 两个人头的白气一起冒。
lines.en: Steam rises from both my heads.

lines.zh: 我跨过一截断掉的树干。
lines.en: I step over a broken trunk.
I stand in the cave mouth without moving.
Snow drifts in from outside.

lines.zh: 四只眼睛轮流眨了一下。
lines.en: My four eyes blink in turn.
The cave is too quiet.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，两个嘴一起。
lines.en: I yawn with both mouths at once.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住半个洞壁。
lines.en: My shadow covers half the wall.
My two heads argue in low voices.
I clench my fist.
The stone creaks under me.
I breathe out, and the fog scatters.

lines.zh: 我弯下腰，你的头顶只到我膝盖。
lines.en: I stoop, and your head barely reaches my knee.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，让两颗头齐平。
lines.en: I crouch until both my heads are level.
Your hands never loosened.
I saw it.
Don't stand in the middle of the cave.
That's the passage.
Your weapon won't stop me.

lines.zh: 溶洞里我站着，顶到洞顶。
lines.en: In the cavern I stand and hit the roof.

lines.zh: 你退一步也不会更安全。
lines.en: A step back won't make you safer.
I can be there in a few steps.
You hit my knee.
I stepped back half a pace in the snow.
It's only on the hide.
The cave wall rang.
Both my heads grin at once.

lines.zh: 你的力气推不动这身骨。
lines.en: Your strength can't shift these bones.
My pauldron stops an axe.

lines.zh: 你把我的皮擦破了一点。
lines.en: You scraped my hide a little.
My shoulder still meets the roof.
Bones are hard. That blow did nothing.
What you hold is too small.
I could swallow you in one bite.
I don't eat this.
Drop the meat and back off ten steps.

lines.zh: 肉味让我两颗头都转了。
lines.en: The smell of meat turns both my heads.
That's not enough.
Holding up that scrap of meat is pitiful.
I'm in no hurry.
There's wind by the cave mouth.
Your dawdling only makes me hungrier.
My leg doesn't budge, like a stone pillar.
This tall, I must look down at you.
You're the one who stepped back.
Don't press against my feet.
I lift a foot, and you must dodge.
You squeezed between my legs.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，洞里都在响。
lines.en: We collided, and the cave rang.
I watch you retreat behind the tree.
My armor knocked the rock wall.
A crack opened in the wall.
I'm the only one in this cave.
Both my heads look away.
There may be some on the tundra.
Go farther away.
My kind is rare.
That's all I'll say.
The wind is coming in again.
You're still here?
I turn around.
Don't follow.

lines.zh: 我三米高的身子，洞里塞不下。
lines.en: Three meters tall — I hardly fit in this cave.
Far too small.
This fell off you.
Three blocks tall in the dripstone cave.
It's a grain of sand in my palm.
Two heads, both shaking no.
I tuck it into my belt pouch.
It flattened in my grip.
The cave doesn't need this.
This may still be of use to you.
You just shifted your foot.
I heard it.
There's a light by the cave mouth.
Not mine.
I turn my whole body. It's slow.
Footsteps carry far in the cave.

lines.zh: 两颗头一起低下来看你。
lines.en: Both heads lower to look at you.
Three meters a step, you cannot outrun that.
Both heads turn toward you together.
I move first.
Your shadow is on the wall.
The left head opens its mouth first.
You backed behind the pillar.
That pillar won't stop my shoulder.
My hand comes up to the roof.
Now it's your turn.

lines.zh: 我踩进溶洞的浅水，水只到脚踝。
lines.en: I step into the cave pool; it reaches my ankles.
The cave is narrow. You can't move fast.
My shadow reaches you first.

lines.zh: 你回头时正见我的影子。
lines.en: You turned right into my shadow.
I'm in no hurry.
Every step of mine lands heavy.
Snow pours in at the mouth.
You ran deeper.
That passage is a dead end.
You'll stop there.
I keep walking.
I know this place better than anyone.
Your steps are slipping in the cave.
I heard you hit a stone.
You're still moving forward.

lines.zh: 我转了个弯，两张脸一起看你。
lines.en: I turn the corner, and both my faces look at you.
The light ahead is dim.
You won't like it there.
I steady myself on the cave roof.
Only a few steps left.
You rolled clear before my foot landed.
The ground dents under my foot.

lines.zh: 你从我两脚之间钻过去。
lines.en: You slip between my two feet.

lines.zh: 两只手一起从上面压下来。
lines.en: Both hands come down from above.
You were shoved into the wall.
This punch is slow, but heavy.
You blocked it.
Your arms are shaking.
I ram with my shoulder.
You slid back a few paces.

lines.zh: 雪原的洞穴里，我慢慢站起来。
lines.en: In a snowy cave, I rise slowly.
You're lifted off the ground.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌盖住你整片影子。
lines.en: My sole covers your whole shadow.
Your feet can't reach the floor.
I loosen my grip a little.
You slide back down.
This kick sends you flying far.

lines.zh: 另一只手从侧面抄过来。
lines.en: My other hand sweeps in from the side.
I'll go slower this time.
You still have a chance.
I come out from deep in the cavern.
My head nearly hit the stalactites.
Snow drifts in from the mouth.
I walk into the light step by step.

lines.zh: 三格高，两个脑袋一起转。
lines.en: Three blocks tall, two heads turning together.

lines.zh: 我把头低到洞口那么低。
lines.en: I lower my head to the cave mouth.
These rocks are very old.
I wipe the wall with a hand.
The cave echoes your breathing.
So you came after all.
I knock my shoulder against the wall.
Stone chips fall everywhere.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的手臂，皮都卷了。
lines.en: Fire caught my arm and the hide curled.

lines.zh: 我从石阶上滑下，撑住了。
lines.en: I slid off the steps and caught myself.

lines.zh: 洞里的水太浅，淹不到我。
lines.en: The water here is too shallow to drown me.

lines.zh: 爆炸把石屑砸了我一身。
lines.en: The blast threw stone chips all over me.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我右肩的厚皮里。
lines.en: The arrow sinks into my right shoulder's hide.
A flash seared across my arm.
Hunger will slow my steps.

lines.zh: 雷声从洞口滚进来，我低下头。
lines.en: Thunder rolled in from the cave mouth. I lowered my head.
No bottom to stand on here.
